name: Afloqualone
summary: A rare analogue of methaqualone, a sedative, intoxicating drug. Similar effects to benzodiazepines, barbiturates and alcohol. Never widely used due to photosensitivity and skin irritation issues, though it has seem some popularity in Japan.

pharmacology.text: Afloqualone (Arofuto) is a quinazolinone family GABAergic drug and is an analogue of methaqualone developed in the 1970s by a team at Tanabe Seiyaku. It has sedative and muscle-relaxant effects resulting from its agonist activity at the β subtype of the GABAa receptor and has had some clinical use, although it causes photosensitization as a side-effect that can cause skin problems such as dermatitis.

summaryZh: 氟喹酮（英語：Afloqualone）或叫氨氟喹酮，是一種喹唑啉酮類GABA能藥物，是田邊製藥的一個團隊在1970年代開發的甲喹酮的類似物。由於其對GABAA受體的β亞型的激動劑活性，它具有鎮靜和肌肉鬆弛作用，並且已經有一些臨床用途，儘管它會導致光敏化作為​​副作用，可能導致皮膚問題，例如皮炎。
summaryZhHans: 氟喹酮（英语：Afloqualone）或叫氨氟喹酮，是一种喹唑啉酮类GABA能药物，是田边制药的一个团队在1970年代开发的甲喹酮的类似物。由于其对GABAA受体的β亚型的激动剂活性，它具有镇静和肌肉松弛作用，并且已经有一些临床用途，尽管它会导致光敏化作为​​副作用，可能导致皮肤问题，例如皮炎。

uses.en: It was used in Japan as a muscle relaxant for conditions involving muscle stiffness and spasm.
uses.zh: 它曾在日本作為肌肉鬆弛劑使用，用於肌肉僵硬與痙攣相關的病症。
uses.zhHans: 它曾在日本作为肌肉松弛剂使用，用于肌肉僵硬与痉挛相关的病症。

sideEffects.en: It causes drowsiness, dizziness, weakness and stomach upset, and it makes the skin unusually sensitive to sunlight, with rashes. Like other drugs of its class it can cause dependence, and stopping suddenly after long use can be dangerous.
sideEffects.zh: 它會引起嗜睡、頭暈、虛弱與腸胃不適，並使皮膚對陽光異常敏感而出現皮疹。和同類其他藥物一樣，它可能造成依賴，長期使用後突然停藥可能有危險。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它会引起嗜睡、头晕、虚弱与肠胃不适，并使皮肤对阳光异常敏感而出现皮疹。和同类其他药物一样，它可能造成依赖，长期使用后突然停药可能有危险。

fact.en: Its parent methaqualone was sold as Quaalude and Mandrax before being banned. Afloqualone was developed in Japan in the 1970s as a muscle relaxant, but a fluorine atom makes it react badly with sunlight.
fact.zh: 它的母體甲喹酮（methaqualone）曾以「Quaalude」與「Mandrax」之名販售，後來被禁。氟喹酮於1970年代在日本開發作為肌肉鬆弛劑，但其中的氟原子讓它對陽光產生不良反應。
fact.zhHans: 它的母体甲喹酮（methaqualone）曾以「Quaalude」与「Mandrax」之名贩售，后来被禁。氟喹酮于1970年代在日本开发作为肌肉松弛剂，但其中的氟原子让它对阳光产生不良反应。
